audience: marketplace sellers who manage orders from several marketplaces in Lengow

useCases.title: Find orders to ship
useCases.text: List the marketplace orders by status or date. Without a date filter, the list covers the last 7 days.

useCases.title: Ship an order with a tracking number
useCases.text: Check the carrier fields that the marketplace requires. Then send a ship action with the tracking number and read the result.

useCases.title: Accept an order on its marketplace
useCases.text: Send an accept action for one order. Lengow runs it in the background, so read the action list to see the result.

useCases.title: Check whether a marketplace action worked
useCases.text: List the actions sent to marketplaces. Each entry shows whether it was processed, and names the error if it failed.

useCases.title: Store your internal order id on a Lengow order
useCases.text: Set your own order id on a Lengow order. Repeating the same call with the same values is safe.
